decisions.statement: The pages are read from the file the service writes rather than assembled.
The panel draws the pages that file has before any change to that file arrives.
The panel draws again when that file is written and at no other time.
A file written while the panel is hidden is kept rather than drawn.
A panel becoming visible with a drawing owed draws the pages the file last said.
The rows the file has are drawn unchanged rather than spelled again.
The rows counted are all the rows.
The pages counted are the rows opening a document.
The badge counts rows while the description counts the rows a filter matched.
A page type no root reaches is said to Alan once and named on the channel.
No watcher on a source file is registered here.
Nothing here decides a row's appearance.

definition: the Pages panel brought up, and the pages drawn into it from one file
